# API Error Codes

<!-- Code generated by scripts/generate_error_catalog.py; DO NOT EDIT. -->

Evydence errors use RFC 9457 Problem Details. `code` and `retry_class` are stable machine-readable values; clients should switch on those fields rather than the human-readable `title` or `detail`.

Every error includes `request_id`. Validation responses may add safe JSON Pointer `violations` with a `field` and a machine-readable `code`; they never contain raw parser, database, provider, or object-store messages.

| Code | HTTP status | Retryable | Retry class | Retry-After | Safe detail |
| --- | ---: | :---: | --- | ---: | --- |
| `VALIDATION_FAILED` | 400 | no | `none` |  | validation failed |
| `UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | no | `none` |  | unauthorized |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | no | `none` |  | forbidden |
| `NOT_FOUND` | 404 | no | `none` |  | not found |
| `VERSION_CONFLICT` | 409 | yes | `refresh_and_retry` |  | resource revision conflict |
| `CONFLICT` | 409 | no | `none` |  | conflict |
| `EVIDENCE_IMMUTABLE` | 409 | no | `none` |  | immutable resource |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED` | 409 | no | `none` |  | idempotency key reused with different request |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | 409 | yes | `idempotency_in_progress` | 1 | idempotency request is in progress |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_FAILED` | 409 | no | `none` |  | idempotency request previously failed |
| `COSIGN_FULL_VERIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE` | 422 | no | `dependency_unavailable` |  | full cosign verification is unavailable because no verifier or trust policy is configured |
| `VERIFICATION_FAILED` | 422 | no | `none` |  | verification failed |
| `RATE_LIMITED` | 429 | yes | `rate_limited` | 60 | rate limited |
| `SIGNING_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE` | 503 | yes | `transient_provider` | 5 | signing provider temporarily unavailable |
| `DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE` | 503 | yes | `dependency_unavailable` | 5 | dependency temporarily unavailable |
| `INTERNAL_ERROR` | 500 | no | `none` |  | internal server error |

`Retry-After` is emitted when the catalog supplies a positive retry interval. A retry class can remain `dependency_unavailable` without being retryable when operator configuration, rather than elapsed time, is required.
